island.name: Phone, internet & paperwork
island.description: Phone calls, mobile and internet contracts, banks and official offices.

sentences.en: Hello, who's speaking?
sentences.ro: Alo, cine e la telefon?

sentences.en: I can't hear you, the signal is bad.
sentences.ro: Nu te aud, am semnal prost.

sentences.en: Can you call me back in ten minutes?
sentences.ro: Poți să mă suni peste zece minute?
sentences.note: "Peste" + time = in / after that much time.

sentences.en: I'll write you a message instead.
sentences.ro: Îți scriu un mesaj în schimb.

sentences.en: My phone battery is almost dead.
sentences.ro: Mi se termină bateria la telefon.

sentences.en: What's the wifi password?
sentences.ro: Care e parola de la wifi?

sentences.en: The internet doesn't work since this morning.
sentences.ro: Internetul nu merge de azi-dimineață.

sentences.en: I'd like to buy a SIM card.
sentences.ro: Aș vrea să cumpăr o cartelă SIM.
sentences.note: "Cartelă" is the word for a prepaid SIM.

sentences.en: How much does the subscription cost per month?
sentences.ro: Cât costă abonamentul pe lună?

sentences.en: I want to cancel my contract.
sentences.ro: Vreau să îmi reziliez contractul.

sentences.en: I need to open a bank account.
sentences.ro: Trebuie să îmi deschid un cont la bancă.

sentences.en: What documents do I need?
sentences.ro: De ce acte am nevoie?
sentences.note: "Acte" is the everyday word for official documents.

sentences.en: Here is my passport and my residence permit.
sentences.ro: Poftiți pașaportul și permisul de ședere.
sentences.note: "Poftiți" is the polite form used with officials.

sentences.en: I don't understand this form.
sentences.ro: Nu înțeleg formularul ăsta.

sentences.en: Where do I have to sign?
sentences.ro: Unde trebuie să semnez?

sentences.en: Can I do this online?
sentences.ro: Pot să fac asta online?

sentences.en: How long does it take?
sentences.ro: Cât durează?

sentences.en: The office is closed on Friday afternoon.
sentences.ro: Biroul e închis vineri după-amiază.

sentences.en: I've been waiting at the counter for an hour.
sentences.ro: Aștept la ghișeu de o oră.
sentences.note: Romanian uses the present with "de" where English uses "have been -ing".

sentences.en: Please send me the confirmation by email.
sentences.ro: Vă rog să îmi trimiteți confirmarea pe email.
